title: You Can Tell a Lot About a Man by How He Treats Women https://thewaysofagentleman.substack.com/p/you-can-tell-a-lot-about-a-man-by-how-he-treats-women
author: The Ways of a Gentleman
source: The Ways of a Gentleman (thewaysofagentleman.substack.com), November 1, 2026
summary: The author argues that a man's character is revealed most clearly in how he treats women when his own desires conflict with what is honorable, and that respect must mean more than opening doors or offering a seat. He rejects the claim that a woman must earn a man's respect and says courtesy is owed to every woman. Against a culture that normalizes pornography and casual romance, he builds a code of conduct: see a woman as a person rather than a means to pleasure, date with her dignity in mind, protect her reputation even after a breakup, and refuse to consume pornography because it separates a woman's body from her humanity. He adds that self-control is strength, that respect must hold when women are absent and men are talking among themselves, and that marriage deepens rather than ends the obligation. The piece closes by saying a gentleman should be able to look back without shame and be the kind of man a father would trust with his daughter. It is a male-formation essay aimed at the home and relationships, which places it in Family.
points: The test of a man's character is how he treats a woman when his desires and his honor pull in different directions, not how well he performs courtesies in public.
Treating a woman as a person with parents, hopes and a future, never as a means to pleasure, should change how a man approaches dating, including how he ends a relationship.
The author links habitual pornography use to a worldview that separates a woman's body from her humanity, and says it cannot be squared with claiming to respect women.
Respect is tested in private: how a man speaks about women among other men, and whether he joins crude talk or shares intimate details to impress friends.
Marriage raises the standard: keep courting your wife, speak well of her when absent, and stay faithful even if no one would ever find out.
quotes: Every woman you meet has a life beyond the few moments you spend with her. She has parents who love her. She has hopes, fears, ambitions, insecurities, and dreams for her future.
One approach treats a woman as a means to satisfy our desires; the other recognizes that how we treat a woman is a reflection of our own character.
If the relationship ends, allow it to end with dignity. Don’t humiliate her afterward by sharing intimate details with your friends.

Pornography encourages a man to separate a woman’s body from her humanity. The person on the screen becomes something to be consumed for gratification, and that mindset probably won’t stay confined to a screen.
Not every desire deserves to be satisfied. There are a lot of things a man might want that wisdom tells him to resist.
Self-control isn’t a weakness; it’s one of the clearest demonstrations of strength. Any man can surrender to his appetites, but it takes discipline to govern them.
It’s easy to behave respectfully when a woman is standing right in front of you. The bigger test comes when she isn’t standing there.
A man’s character isn’t revealed by what he can get away with. It’s revealed by what he refuses to do even when he could.
